title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement

---

## Problem

What are you trying to do, and what gets in the way today?

## Proposed solution

What you would like to happen. For a new data source, include the provider,
what it covers (market / event type), whether it needs an API key, and a link
to its terms of use.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches or workarounds.

## Additional context

Anything else (links, examples). Check "Roadmap / known gaps" in
`docs/architecture.md` first; it may already be planned.
